data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Tickets-branch commit mechanism — DO NOT raw git commit to tickets orphan branch (no helper exists). Instead use the existing dso ticket CLI: (a) write artifacts to .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/ on the WORKING TREE (not tickets branch), (b) call .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <epic-id> '...artifact-bundle...' with the bundle content (or file paths) as comment body — this attaches the artifact to the epic ticket on the tickets branch via the canonical ticket CLI. Concurrency: ticket CLI has its own internal lock; on lock-conflict retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (250ms, 500ms, 1s) before failing with exit 6 + 'tickets branch lock conflict — retry exhausted' diagnostic.
